newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT -T-bonds look for cautious moves to 114-26.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT -T-bonds look for cautious moves to 114-26.

text.p: September T-bonds will look to retrace some of the recent sharp falls on Wednesday, but will find their upside blocked initially at 114-26, technical analysts said.
The 114-26 level was an area of intraday congestion, and above there 115-02, the August 4 high would come into play.

"There's a positive divergence on the rising intraday studies," said Mike Macdonald, technical analyst at 4CAST in London. "The gradual erosion we've seen since Friday is now going to allow limited moves up."
September T-bond futures were down 4/32 at 114-15 in automated trade by 1000 GMT.
However, Macdonald said any moves above the 115-02 level would be fitful.
"It's likely to be exhausted beneath the July 29 115-09 high," he said. If it did get above there, then 115-26 is the 50 percent retracement of Friday's drop from 116-31 to 114-24.

Susan Rigg, technical analyst at Chart Analysis in London said September T-bonds still had downside potential. She said an aggressive move to the upside would be needed to negate the scope of the correction.

"An upward dynamic --a good move to the upside and a close at higher levels-- would be needed to show support was being found, but at the moment we are likely to see a bit more drift on the downside," said Rigg.
The first sign that strength might be coming in would be if T-bonds moved above 115-02 but that would be limited, she said.
"Since Friday's sharp fall from (around) 117-00 the market has been drifting on the downside," she said.

"Although there is further strength in the market this downward dynamic is the first safehaven we have had since the market started moving up aggressively in mid-April which suggests a top has been reached."
Macdonald cited support at 113-27/30 from the lows on July 21 and 22.
Below there a one-month trendline drawn from the July 7 and 13 lows at 113-03 and 113-07 comes in at 113-19.
"That's the maximum downside I expect today," he said.
At the short end, December Eurodollars were unchanged at 94.075.
